ID_ITEMSKINS_TABNAME.Note: Name of the tab inside the inspect view

ID_ITEMSKINS_STENCILPARTS.Note: Name of the new basic material that goes into applying a weapon stencil

ID_ITEMSKINS_VIEW_ALL.Note: Callout in the bottom left that opens an "all stencils" view

ID_ITEMSKINS_STENCIL_NOT_LEARNED.Note: Disclaimer text for the situation when you have found a stencil but you haven't yet "learn and consumed" it, like for blueprints

ID_ITEMSKINS_LEARN_AND_CONSUME.Note: Button CTA that allows the player to learn and consume the stencil

ID_ITEMSKINS_ACTIONMENU_SHORTCUT.Note: Shortcut in the tile right click action menu

ID_ITEMSKINS_COMPATIBILITY.Note: Stencil tooltip compatibility text; tag contains weapon names

ID_ITEMSKINS_WEAPON_TOOLTIP_STENCILROW.Note: Visible in the weapon tooltip to display the stencil to the player (notice the "Stencil    Burgundy Moon" line)

ID_ITEMSKINS_STENCIL_INSTANCE.Note: For cases when a raider loots a weapon with a stencil applied, but doesn't yet own that stencil for repeated use.Tag contains stencil name

ID_ITEMSKINS_DISPLAY_TAG_BASE_APPEARANCE.Note: Copy to show to the player when they're looking at their weapon it is original, non-stencilled, non-ascended look.
